thread:
sam: Heads up — release train freeze starts Friday 22:00 PT for the long weekend. Locking feature flags and blocking non-critical rollouts. :lock:

sam: Quick checklist we expect folks to follow before freeze:
- freeze feature branches
- stop scheduled canaries
- finalize canary regression windows
- tag release-candidate
- run smoke post-deploy

jess: @sam timeline for hotpatches? We may need a small patch for the embeddings endpoint.

sam: Hotpatches allowed until 20:00 PT Fri if approved by release lead @mario. After 20:00 only emergency fixes (SEV>=2) with oncall + release lead signoff. :rotating_light:

mario: I'll be release lead for this cycle. Ping me in thread with PR number and a 1-line risk summary.

deploy-bot: canary-status — 3/3 canaries healthy, p99 latency 99.92% (within SLO), error rate 0.03% — no regressions.

anya: Noted. I have a low-risk quantization change in staging. Can I queue it for early Friday morning canary? (non-blocking)

mario: Queue only if it passes the staging smoke by 06:00 PT. Otherwise hold for next train.

devops: FYI we're pausing autoscale policy changes during the freeze window.

jess: Checklist link: https://redwood.infra/release-checklist (please review the rollback section)

sam: Reminder: Any DB schema changes require a migration plan + backout steps. @eng-sre please confirm no migrations during freeze.

eng-sre: Confirmed — no schema migrations during freeze unless coordinated and scheduled off-hours with explicit runway and playbook.

jess: quick smoke output: ```kubectl rollout status deploy/embeddings-svc -n prod --watch=false
deployment "embeddings-svc" successfully rolled out
```

mario: Hotpatch rules: include a 1-line risk summary, PR link, and run a 2% traffic canary for 15m before wider rollout. Tag branch/PR with `hotpatch/` prefix.

deploy-bot: deploy request 1832503001 accepted for PR #2487 by jess — canary at 2% scheduled 2026-03-27T05:30:00Z

jess: Thanks — I'll be on watch for the 15m window.

sam: Last call — freeze starts in ~12h. If you were planning anything non-emergency, please move it to the next cycle.

anya: Copy, scheduler adjusted and QA notified.

mario: TL;DR: freeze Fri 22:00 PT, hotpatches allowed until 20:00 PT with release-lead signoff, emergencies OK with oncall+lead. Release lead: mario. See checklist link above. :white_check_mark:
